response.sql: WITH scan_metrics AS (SELECT crewref, CASE WHEN spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0 AND gbsize IS NOT NULL THEN gbsize / CAST(spanmin AS REAL) ELSE NULL END as gb_per_min FROM scans), operator_stats AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) as scan_count, AVG(gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min FROM scan_metrics GROUP BY crewref), all_operator_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as overall_avg FROM operator_stats), filtered_operators AS (SELECT os.scan_count, os.avg_gb_per_min, aoa.overall_avg FROM operator_stats os CROSS JOIN all_operator_avg aoa WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > aoa.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(CAST(scan_count AS REAL)) as avg_scan_count, AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min, AVG(avg_gb_per_min - overall_avg) as avg_margin_above FROM filtered_operators
